help:
usage: agent-comms [-h] [--root ROOT]
                   {tools,import-thread,invoke,send,user-send,configure,pin-constraint,pin-input-constraint,approve-annotations,correct-annotation,annotations,supersede-constraint,drop-constraint,export-retained,inbox,watch,ack,who,status,history,export-wire,channels,threads,thread,register,heartbeat,attach-session,schema-report,checkpoint,activity,stop,restart,release,archive,delete,rename-self,fork,ledger,poll,context,target-actions,target-action,start,thread-tags,rename-tag,delete-tag,archive-channel,restore-channel,delete-view,pin-channel,channel-activity,target-edit,read-target,pin-thread} ...

OpenHCS agent communications — JSON CLI. Commands print one JSON result,
except watch, which streams messages as JSON lines. They exit 0 on success or
1 with ``{"error": ...}`` on failure. This is the adapter surface for the pi
extension and other process-based clients: they shell out and parse JSON, they
do not own orchestration semantics.

positional arguments:
  {tools,import-thread,invoke,send,user-send,configure,pin-constraint,pin-input-constraint,approve-annotations,correct-annotation,annotations,supersede-constraint,drop-constraint,export-retained,inbox,watch,ack,who,status,history,export-wire,channels,threads,thread,register,heartbeat,attach-session,schema-report,checkpoint,activity,stop,restart,release,archive,delete,rename-self,fork,ledger,poll,context,target-actions,target-action,start,thread-tags,rename-tag,delete-tag,archive-channel,restore-channel,delete-view,pin-channel,channel-activity,target-edit,read-target,pin-thread}
    tools               Emit the shared adapter tool catalog
    import-thread       Import an OpenCode/Codex context snapshot
    invoke              Invoke one declared adapter tool
    send                Send to a thread (DM), #channel, or #all
    user-send           Send as the human user to a thread (DM), #channel, or
                        #all
    configure           Set a stopped thread's model, thinking level, or
                        service tier for its next start
    pin-constraint      Pin a certified original human message for its
                        recipient
    pin-input-constraint
                        Pin an original human input for its recipient
    approve-annotations
                        Approve a pinned external classifier using original
                        human wording and an hourly request budget
    correct-annotation  Correct one original stored model answer through the
                        human identity owner
    annotations         Report human-reviewed accuracy and probability
                        frequencies for exact annotation versions
    supersede-constraint
                        Publish a human's exact replacement for an authored
                        constraint
    drop-constraint     Retire a constraint by original reference, preserving
                        its evidence
    export-retained     Export current authored context from original
                        certified sources
    inbox               Undelivered messages for a thread
    watch               Stream unread and arriving messages as JSON lines
    ack                 Mark inbox delivered
    who                 Presence: who is in the chat
    status              Live activity: what each thread is doing right now
    history             Full history of a DM, channel, or everything
    export-wire         Export durable IRC/wire message history
    channels            Derived channel list
    threads             List threads
    thread              Detail for one thread
    register            Register a thread
    heartbeat           Mark thread running
    attach-session      Attach a live Pi session to a registered thread
    schema-report       Report declared DDL differences in existing SQLite
                        stores (including retained copies)
    checkpoint          Commit and push a thread's uncommitted worktree
                        changes as a checkpoint branch
    activity            Publish current thread activity
    stop                Stop process
    restart             Restart process
    release             Voluntarily mark the calling thread stopped
    archive             Archive a stopped thread
    delete              Permanently delete a stopped or archived thread; its
                        bus history stays
    rename-self         Rename your own running thread
    fork                Fork a child pi thread
    ledger              Read or merge ledger state
    poll                Status snapshot: thread, inbox, ledger, peers
    context             Inspect original context contributors without sending
                        an input
    target-actions      List applicable operations and their declared
                        parameters
    target-action       Execute a declared operation against its current
                        target
    start               Start thread
    thread-tags         Edit thread tags
    rename-tag          Rename channel tag
    delete-tag          Remove tag, archive tagged threads, or delete tagged
                        threads
    archive-channel     Archive channel
    restore-channel     Restore archived channel
    delete-view         Delete saved view
    pin-channel         Set channel pin
    channel-activity    Toggle member activity
    target-edit         Execute a declared operation using its original CLI
                        field parsers
    read-target         Mark view read
    pin-thread          Toggle thread pin in channel

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Comms root directory (default $AGENT_COMMS_ROOT,
                        active route, or ~/.agent-comms)
